pages.text: Blocks that produce cobblestone. $(br)Right-click with an empty hand to take out one stack, or Sneak + right-click to check how many are stored inside.
The most basic cobblestone generator. $(br)It produces cobblestone at a rate of 1 per second.
Upgrading it increases cobblestone production. $(br)Higher tiers produce more cobblestone per second.
Nine cobblestone generators can be combined at the Alchemy Table to create a compressed generator that produces x9 compressed cobblestone.
Similarly, 25 x9 compressed cobblestone generators can be combined at Hermes's Workbench to create a generator that produces x225 compressed cobblestone.
Similarly, 169 x225 compressed cobblestone generators can be combined at the Transcendental Table to create a generator that produces x38025 compressed cobblestone.
